about.headline: Software architecture
about.headlineAccent: Every technical decision accounts for maintainability, security and scalability. Design precedes implementation, changes are validated through automated testing, and releases are deployed automatically.

performance.title: Web performance & SEO
performance.description: SSR, CDNs and optimized images for fast loads and strong search rankings.

async.title: Queues & background jobs
async.description: BullMQ and Redis queues with retries, backoff and idempotency.

security.title: Secure APIs & authentication
security.description: Token rotation, RBAC, rate limiting and encrypted secrets.

design.title: System design
design.description: Data models, APIs and modules designed to grow without rewrites.

quality.title: Automated testing & CI/CD
quality.description: Automated tests and pipelines that block the merge when something breaks.

ai.title: AI-assisted development
ai.description: Claude Code and Antigravity integrated into the development workflow, with code review and testing as quality control.

about.techSubtitle: The technologies and tools behind every system I architect. I integrate modern tooling and automation into my engineering workflow to move fast while maintaining strict reliability, code quality, and performance.

ecommerce.title: La Casa del Balompié
ecommerce.description: An online store for soccer jerseys in Guatemala, with orders handled directly via the owner's WhatsApp. Clean, responsive design built to turn visits into real sales.

qably.title: Qably Development AI
qably.description: A software quality SaaS that ingests CI/CD reports, generates test cases with AI from every commit, and traces them end to end. Multi-tenant, with BullMQ and Redis queues and more than 4,900 automated tests.

envault.title: EnVault Management
envault.description: A system that schedules, queues and ships PostgreSQL and MySQL dumps to Cloudflare R2 with Redis and BullMQ. Retries with backoff, distributed locks to run across replicas, SHA-256 checks before every restore, and real-time progress.

saas.title: Restaurant SaaS
saas.description: A multi-tenant platform where each restaurant manages its own landing page with one of two designs, Urban or Elegant, and sells online. It includes a digital menu, direct orders, push notifications and a management dashboard with sales analytics.

mps.title: MPS de Guatemala
mps.description: An online store for tech devices with server-side rendering, a role-based admin panel with analytics, oversell-proof stock control and real-time order tracking. Delivered and being prepared for launch.

turboauto.title: Turbo Auto
turboauto.description: Digital presence for a mechanic shop and carwash in Quesada, Jutiapa. Showcases their services, includes an exclusive deals section, and pulls in local customers with a clean, professional look.

contact.title: From design to production
contact.subtitle: Every project, whether proprietary or built for clients, follows the same development cycle. It covers problem analysis, architecture design and test-backed implementation, and concludes with the release of stable software to production.

seo.title: Isaac Sarceño | Software Engineer
seo.description: Software engineer in Guatemala. Design and development of SaaS and e-commerce platforms with React, TypeScript, and Node.js, from architecture to deployment.
